schema.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The domain name that you want to add to WAF.

The IP address or domain name of the origin server. You can specify only one type of address.

*   If you use an IP address, specify the value in the `["ip1","ip2",...]` format. You can specify up to 20 IP addresses.
*   If you use a domain name, specify the value in the `["domain"]` format. You can enter only one domain name.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns**.

Specifies whether a Layer 7 proxy is configured in front of WAF. A Layer 7 proxy is used to filter inbound traffic before the traffic reaches the WAF instance. Layer 7 proxies include Anti-DDoS Pro, Anti-DDoS Premium, and Alibaba Cloud CDN. Valid values:

*   **0**: No Layer 7 proxy is configured in front of WAF.
*   **1**: A Layer 7 proxy is configured in front of WAF.

The method that you want WAF to use to obtain the actual IP address of a client. Valid values:

*   **0**: WAF reads the first value of the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header field as the actual IP address of a client. This is the default value.
*   **1**: WAF reads the value of a custom header field as the actual IP address of a client.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **IsAccessProduct** to **1**.

The custom header fields that you want WAF to use to obtain the actual IP address of a client. Specify the value in the `["header1","header2",...]` format.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessHeaderMode** to **1**.

The load balancing algorithm that you want WAF to use to forward requests to the origin server. Valid values:

*   **0**: The IP hash algorithm.
*   **1**: The round-robin algorithm.
*   **2**: The least time algorithm.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns**.

The key-value pairs that you want to use to label the requests that pass through the WAF instance.

Specify the key-value pair in the `[{"k":"_key_","v":"_value_"}]` format. `key` is the custom header field, and `value` is the value of the custom header field.

The WAF can automatically add custom key-value pairs as traffic markers to the request headers of traffic destined for the protected domain. This allows backend services to easily identify requests that have passed through the WAF.

>  If a request contains a custom header field, WAF overwrites the original value of the field with the specified value.

The HTTPS ports. Specify the value in the `["port1","port2",...]` format.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns**. If you specify this parameter, your website uses HTTP. You must specify **HttpPort** or **HttpsPort**.

The HTTPS ports. Specify the value in the `["port1","port2",...]` format.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns**. If you specify this parameter, your website uses HTTPS. You must specify **HttpPort** or **HttpsPort**.

The HTTP/2 ports. Specify the value in the `["port1","port2",...]` format.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and specify **HttpsPort**.

Specifies whether to enable HTTPS to HTTP redirection for back-to-origin requests. If you enable this feature, WAF forwards requests to the origin server over HTTP. The default port is 80. Valid values:

*   **0**: Disables HTTPS to HTTP redirection for back-to-origin requests. This is the default value.
*   **1**: Enables HTTPS to HTTP redirection for back-to-origin requests.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and specify **HttpsPort**.

Specifies whether to enable the feature of redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS requests. Specifies whether to enable HTTP to HTTPS redirection. If you enable this feature, requests are sent over HTTPS. The default port is 443. Valid values:

*   **0**: Disables HTTP to HTTPS redirection. This is the default value.
*   **1**: Enables HTTP to HTTPS redirection.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and specify **HttpsPort**.

The type of the WAF protection cluster. Valid values:

*   **0**: Shared cluster. This is the default value.
*   **1**: Exclusive cluster.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns**.

The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which specifies that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see [Create a resource group](~~94485~~).

The timeout period for connections of WAF exclusive clusters. Unit: seconds.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and **ClusterType** to **1**.

The timeout period for read connections of WAF exclusive clusters. Unit: seconds.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and **ClusterType** to **1**.

The timeout period for write connections of WAF exclusive clusters. Unit: seconds.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and **ClusterType** to **1**.

The mode in which you want to add the domain name to WAF. Valid values:

*   **waf-cloud-dns**: CNAME record mode. This is the default value.
*   **waf-cloud-native**: Transparent proxy mode.

The list of server and port configurations for the transparent proxy mode. Set the value to a string that consists of JSON arrays. Each element in a JSON array is a JSON struct that contains the following fields:

*   **ProtocolPortConfigs**: The list of protocol and port configurations. This field is required. Data type: array. Each element in a JSON array is a JSON struct that contains the following fields:

    *   **Ports**:The list of ports. This field is required. Data type: array. Specify the value in the `[port1,port2,……]` format.
    *   **Protocol**: The protocol. This field is required. Data type: string. Valid values: **http** and **https**.

*   **CloudNativeProductName**: The type of the cloud service instance. This field is required. Data type: string. Valid values: **ECS**, **SLB**, and **ALB**.

*   **RedirectionTypeName**: The type of traffic redirection port. This field is required. Data type: string. Valid values: **ECS**, **SLB-L4**, **SLB-L7**, and **ALB**.

*   **InstanceId**: The ID of the cloud service instance. This field is required. Data type: string.

*   **IPAddressList**: The list of public IP addresses of the cloud service instance. This field is required. Data type: array. Specify the value in the `["ip1","ip2",...]` format.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-native**.

Specifies whether to enable the feature of forwarding requests to the origin servers that use the IP address type specified in the requests. If you enable the feature, WAF forwards requests from IPv4 addresses to origin servers that use IPv4 addresses and requests from IPv6 addresses to origin servers that use IPv6 addresses. Valid values:

*   **0**: Disables the feature of forwarding requests to the origin servers that use the IP address type that is specified in the requests. This is the default value.
*   **1**: Enables the feature of forwarding requests to the origin servers that use the IP address type that is specified in the requests.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns**.

Specifies whether to enable origin Server Name Indication (SNI). Origin SNI specifies the domain name that must be used for establishing an HTTPS connection during the initial handshake. This occurs when the WAF forwards requests to the origin server. If the origin server hosts multiple domain names, you must enable this feature. Valid values:

*   **0**: Disables origin SNI.
*   **1**: Enables origin SNI.

By default, origin SNI is disabled for WAF instances in Chinese mainland and enabled for WAF instances outside the Chinese mainland.

>  This parameter is required only if you set **AccessType** to **waf-cloud-dns** and specify **HttpsPort**.

The value of the custom SNI extended field. If you do not specify this parameter, the value of the **Host** field in the request header is automatically used as the value of the SNI field.

In most cases, you do not need to specify a custom value for the SNI field. However, if you want WAF to use an SNI field whose value is different from the value of the Host header field in back-to-origin requests, you can specify a custom value for the SNI field.

>  This parameter is required only if you set SniStatus to **1**.

Specifies whether WAF retries to forward requests when the requests fail to be forwarded to the origin server. Valid values:

*   **true** (default)
*   **false**

Specifies whether to enable the persistent connection feature. Valid values:

*   **true** (default)
*   **false**

The number of requests that reuse persistent connections. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

>  This parameter specifies the number of persistent connections that can be reused after you enable the persistent connection feature.

The timeout period of persistent connections that are in the idle state. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 15. Unit: seconds.

>  This parameter specifies the duration for which a reused persistent connection can remain in the idle state before it is released.

The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

The domain name to which the protection rule configuration will be applied.  

> You can call [DescribeDomainNames](~~86373~~) to query all domain names that have been added to WAF for protection.

The protection feature module to configure. Valid values:  

- **waf-codec**: indicates Protection Rules Engine decoding settings.  

- **tamperproof**: indicates website tamper-proofing rule configuration.  

- **dlp**: indicates sensitive information leakage prevention rule configuration.  

- **ng_account**: indicates account security rule configuration.  

- **antifraud**: indicates data risk control protection request configuration.  

- **antifraud_js**: indicates data risk control JavaScript insertion page configuration.  

- **bot_algorithm**: indicates intelligent algorithm rules for bot management.  

- **bot_wxbb_pkg**: indicates version protection rules for app protection.  

- **bot_wxbb**: indicates path protection rules for app protection.  

- **ac_custom**: indicates custom mitigation policies rule configuration.  

- **whitelist**: indicates whitelist rule configuration.

The rule configuration content, converted into a string from a JSON-formatted structure composed of a series of parameters.  

> The specific parameters involved vary depending on the configured protection feature module (**DefenseType**). For details, see the specific description of the Rule parameter.

CreateProtectionModuleRule.summary: You can create configuration rules in the specified WAF function modules, such as web intrusion protection, Data Security, advanced mitigation, Bot, Resource Access Management, and Rate Limiting.
CreateProtectionModuleRule.description:
This API is used to create rule configurations in a specified WAF protection feature module, such as web intrusion protection, data security, advanced mitigation, bot management, resource access management, or rate limiting. You can specify the protection feature module by setting the **DefenseType** parameter. For the meanings of specific parameter values, see the description of the **DefenseType** request parameter.  
Note that to ensure system documentation integrity, the queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be rate-limited, which may affect your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
CreateProtectionModuleRule.requestParamsDescription:
**Detailed description of rule parameters**

 - The JSON string corresponding to the **Rule Protection Engine decoding settings** (**waf-codec**) contains the following parameters:

    - **codecList**: Array type | Required | Enabled decoding configuration items. You can view the supported values for this parameter in the Web Application Firewall console.

   - **Sample**
    ```
    {
        "codecList":["url","base64"]
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **Website Tamper-Proofing rule configuration** (**tamperproof**) contains the following parameters:

    - **uri**: String type | Required | The specific URL to be protected.
    - **name**: String type | Required | Rule name.

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "name":"example",
        "uri":"http://www.aliyundoc.com/example"
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) rule configuration** (**dlp**) contains the following parameters:

    - **name**: String type | Required | Rule name.
    - **conditions**: Array type | Required | Matching conditions described in JSON string format. Up to two matching conditions can be configured, and the relationship between them is logical AND. This includes the following specific parameters:

        - **key**: Matching item. Valid values:
            - **0**: Indicates the protected URL.
            - **10**: Indicates sensitive information.
            - **11**: Indicates response code.
            > You cannot configure matching conditions for both response code (**11**) and sensitive information (**10**) simultaneously in the **conditions** parameter.

        - **operation**: Matching logic. Fixed value: **1**, indicating "contains".

        - **value**: Describes the matching condition values in JSON string format. Multiple values are supported. It includes the following specific parameters:

            - **v**: Applicable only when the matching item (**key**) is URL (**0**) or response code (**11**).
                - URL: When `"key":0`, the parameter value is the URL address.
                - Response code: When `"key":11`, valid values include **400**, **401**, **402**, **403**, **404**, **405-499**, **500**, **501**, **502**, **503**, **504**, **505-599**.
            - **k**: Applicable only when the matching item (**key**) is sensitive information (**10**). Valid values:
                - **100**: Indicates ID card number.
                - **101**: Indicates credit card number.
                - **102**: Indicates phone number.
                - **103**: Indicates default sensitive words.

    - **action**: Matching action. Valid values:
        - **3**: Indicates alerting.
        - **10**: Indicates sensitive information filtering. This action applies only to matching conditions where `"key":10`.
        - **11**: Indicates returning the system's built-in block page. This action applies only to matching conditions where `"key":11`.

    - **Sample**

  ```
  {
	"name":"example",
	"conditions":[{"key":11,"operation":1,"value":[{"v":401}]},{"key":"0","operation":1,"value":[{"v":"www.aliyundoc.com"}]}],
	"action":3
  }
  ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **Account Security rule configuration** (**ng_account**) contains the following parameters:

    - **url_path**: String type | Required | Detection API endpoint, represented as a URL path. Must start with a forward slash (/).
    - **method**: String type | Required | Request methods to be detected, including POST, GET, PUT, DELETE. Multiple request methods can be specified, separated by commas (,).
    - **account_left**: String type | Required | Account parameter name.
    - **password_left**: String type | Optional | Password parameter name.
    - **action**: String type | Required | Protection action. Valid values:
        - **monitor**: Indicates alerting.
        - **block**: Indicates blocking.

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "url_path":"/example",
        "method":"POST,GET,PUT,DELETE",
        "account_left":"aaa",
        "password_left":"123",
        "action":"monitor"
    }
    ``` 

- The JSON string corresponding to the **Data Risk Control protection request configuration** (**antifraud**) contains the following parameters:

    - **uri**: String type | Required | Specific protection request URL.
    
    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "uri": "http://1.example.com/example"
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **Data Risk Control JS insertion page configuration** (**antifraud_js**) contains the following parameters:

    - **uri**: String type | Required | URL of the page where the Data Risk Control JS should be inserted. The system inserts the JS into all pages under the specified URL path. Must start with a forward slash (/).

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "uri": "/example/example"
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **Bot Management intelligent algorithm rule configuration** (**bot_algorithm**) contains the following parameters:

    - **name**: String type | Required | Rule name.
    - **algorithmName**: String type | Required | Algorithm name. Valid values:
        - **RR**: Indicates specialized resource crawler detection algorithm.
        - **PR**: Indicates targeted path crawler detection algorithm.
        - **DPR**: Indicates parameter polling crawler detection algorithm.
        - **SR**: Indicates dynamic IP crawler detection algorithm.
        - **IND**: Indicates proxy device crawler detection algorithm.
        - **Periodicity**: Indicates periodic crawler detection algorithm.
    - **timeInterval**: Integer type | Required | Detection period. Valid values: 30, 60, 120, 300, 600. Unit: seconds.
    - **action**: String type | Required | Enforcement action. Valid values:
        - **monitor**: Indicates observation.
        - **captcha**: Indicates slider challenge.
        - **js**: Indicates JavaScript validation.
        - **block**: Indicates blocking. When **block** is selected, the **blocktime** parameter (blocking duration) must be provided.
    - **blocktime**: Integer type | Optional | Blocking duration. Unit: minutes. Valid range: 1–600.
    - **config**: String type | Required | Algorithm configuration information in JSON string format. The specific sub-parameters depend on the selected **algorithmName**.
        - Configuration for the **Specialized Resource Crawler Detection Algorithm (RR)** includes the following sub-parameters:
            - **resourceType**: Integer type | Optional | Requested resource type. Valid values:
                - **1**: Indicates dynamic resource type.
                - **2**: Indicates static resource type.
                - **-1**: Indicates custom resource type. When **-1** is selected, the **extensions** parameter must also be provided as a comma-separated string of specific file extensions, for example: `css,jpg,xls`.
            - **minRequestCountPerIp**: Integer type | Required | Minimum number of requests per IP within the detection period. Only IPs with request counts greater than or equal to this value are monitored. Valid range: 5–10000.
            - **minRatio**: Float type | Required | Risk determination threshold, which is the ratio of requests targeting the specified resource type (for RR) or specified path (for PR) among all requests from an IP. If exceeded, the IP is considered risky. Valid range: 0.01–1.
        - Configuration for the **Targeted Path Crawler Detection Algorithm (PR)** includes the following sub-parameters:
            - **keyPathConfiguration**: Array type | Optional | Request path information. Up to 10 paths can be specified. This parameter is required only when using the PR algorithm. Represented in JSON string format with the following fields:
                - **method**: String type | Required | Request method. Valid values: **POST**, **GET**, **PUT**, **DELETE**, **HEAD**, **OPTIONS**.
                - **url**: String type | Required | Request path keyword. Must start with a forward slash (/).
                - **matchType**: String type | Required | Matching mode used together with the **url** parameter to define the request path. Valid values: **all** (exact match), **prefix** (prefix match), **regex** (regular expression match).
            - **minRequestCountPerIp**: Integer type | Required | Minimum number of requests per IP within the detection period. Only IPs with request counts greater than or equal to this value are monitored. Valid range: 5–10000.
            - **minRatio**: Float type | Required | Risk determination threshold, which is the ratio of requests targeting the specified resource type (for RR) or specified path (for PR) among all requests from an IP. If exceeded, the IP is considered risky. Valid range: 0.01–1.
        - Configuration for the **Parameter Polling Crawler Detection Algorithm (DPR)** includes the following sub-parameters:
            - **method**: String type | Required | Request method. Valid values: **POST**, **GET**, **PUT**, **DELETE**, **HEAD**, **OPTIONS**.
            - **urlPattern**: String type | Required | Key parameter path. Must start with a forward slash (/). Use {} to denote key parameters. When multiple {} are configured, they are concatenated as the key parameter. For example: `/company/{}/{}/{}/user.php?uid={}`.
            - **minRequestCountPerIp**: Integer type | Required | Minimum number of requests per IP within the detection period. Only IPs with request counts greater than or equal to this value are monitored. Valid range: 5–10000.
            - **minRatio**: Float type | Required | Risk determination threshold, which is the ratio of distinct key parameter values in requests from an IP. If exceeded, the IP is considered risky. Valid range: 0.01–1.
        - Configuration for the **Dynamic IP Crawler Detection Algorithm (SR)** includes the following sub-parameters:
            - **maxRequestCountPerSrSession**: Integer type | Required | Defines abnormal sessions by setting the maximum number of requests allowed per session. A session with fewer requests than this value is considered abnormal. Valid range: 1–8.
            - **minSrSessionCountPerIp**: Integer type | Required | Risk determination threshold, which is the number of abnormal sessions from an IP. If exceeded, the IP is considered risky. Valid range: 5–300.
        - Configuration for the **Proxy Device Crawler Detection Algorithm (IND)** includes the following sub-parameters:
            - **minIpCount**: Integer type | Required | Malicious device determination threshold, which is the number of distinct IPs associated with a device via Wi-Fi. If exceeded, the device is considered risky. Valid range: 5–500.
            - **keyPathConfiguration**: Array type | Optional | Detection path information. Up to 10 paths can be specified. Represented in JSON string format with the following fields:
                - **method**: String type | Required | Request method. Valid values: **POST**, **GET**, **PUT**, **DELETE**, **HEAD**, **OPTIONS**.
                - **url**: String type | Required | Detection path keyword. Must start with a forward slash (/).
                - **matchType**: String type | Required | Matching mode used together with the **url** parameter to define the request path. Valid values: **all** (exact match), **prefix** (prefix match), **regex** (regular expression match).
        - Configuration for the **Periodic Crawler Detection Algorithm (Periodicity)** includes the following sub-parameters:
            - **minRequestCountPerIp**: Integer type | Required | Minimum number of requests per IP within the detection period. Only IPs with request counts greater than or equal to this value are monitored. Valid range: 5–10000.
            - **level**: Integer type | Required | Risk determination level, indicating the prominence of periodic behavior in the IP’s access pattern. Valid values:
                - **0**: Indicates prominent.
                - **1**: Indicates moderate.
                - **2**: Indicates weak.
    - **Sample**
    ```
    {
        "name":"Proxy Device Crawler Detection",
        "algorithmName":"IND",
        "timeInterval":"60",
        "action":"monitor",
        "config":{
            "minIpCount":5,
            "keyPathConfiguration":[{"url":"/index","method":"GET","matchType":"prefix"}]
        }
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **App Protection version protection rule configuration** (**bot_wxbb_pkg**) contains the following parameters:

    - **name**: String type | Required | Rule name.
    - **action**: String type | Required | Enforcement action. Valid values:
        - **test**: Indicates observation.
        - **close**: Indicates blocking.
    - **nameList**: Array type | Required | Valid version information. Up to five rules can be specified. Represented in JSON string format with the following fields:
        - **name**: String type | Required | Valid package name.
        - **signList**: Array type | Required | Corresponding package signatures. Up to 15 signatures can be specified, separated by commas (,).

    - **Sample**
    ```
    {
        "name":"test",
        "action":"close",
        "nameList":[{
            "name":"apk-xxxx",
            "signList":["xxxxxx","xxxxx","xxxx","xx"]
        }]
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the **App Protection path protection rule configuration** (**bot_wxbb**) contains the following parameters:

    - **name**: String type | Required | Rule name.
    - **uri**: String type | Required | Protection path. Must start with a forward slash (/).
    - **matchType**: String type | Required | Matching mode. Valid values: **all** (exact match), **prefix** (prefix match), **regex** (regular expression match).
    - **arg**: String type | Required | Parameter inclusion, used together with the **matchType** parameter to define the protection path configuration.
    - **action**: String type | Required | Enforcement action. Valid values:
        - **test**: Indicates observation.
        - **close**: Indicates blocking.
    - **hasTag**: Boolean type | Required | Indicates whether a custom signing field is required.
        - **true**: Indicates yes. When set to true, the **wxbbVmpFieldType** and **wxbbVmpFieldValue** parameters must be provided to specify the signing field type and value.
        - **false**: Indicates no.
    - **wxbbVmpFieldType**: Integer type | Optional | Custom signing field type. Required when **hasTag** is **true**. Valid values:
        - **0**: Indicates header.
        - **1**: Indicates parameter.
        - **2**: Indicates cookie.
    - **wxbbVmpFieldValue**: String type | Optional | Custom signing field value. Required when **hasTag** is **true**.
    - **blockInvalidSign**: Integer type | Required | Indicates whether to enforce actions on invalid signatures. Fixed value: **1**. This is the default mitigation policy for path protection rules.
    - **blockProxy**: Integer type | Optional | Indicates whether to enforce actions on proxy traffic. Fixed value: **1**. Omit this parameter if no enforcement is needed for proxy traffic.
    - **blockSimulator**: Integer type | Optional | Indicates whether to enforce actions on emulator traffic. Fixed value: **1**. Omit this parameter if no enforcement is needed for emulator traffic.

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "name":"test",
        "uri":"/index",
        "matchType":"all",
        "arg":"test",
        "action":"close",
        "hasTag":true,
        "wxbbVmpFieldType":2,
        "wxbbVmpFieldValue":"test",
        "blockInvalidSign":1,
        "blockProxy":1
    }
    ```

DescribeProtectionModuleRules.responseParamsDescription:
**Detailed description of the Content parameter**

 - The JSON string corresponding to the Protection Rules Engine decoding settings (**waf-codec**) contains the following parameters:

    - **codecList**: String | Required | Enabled decoding configuration items.

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "codecList":["url","base64"]
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the website tamper-proofing rule configuration (**tamperproof**) contains the following parameters:

    - **uri**: String | Required | The specific URL to be protected.
    - **name**: String | Required | Rule name.
    - **status**: Integer | Optional | Protection status of the rule:
        - **0** (default): Indicates inactive.
        - **1**: Indicates active.

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "name":"example",
        "uri":"http://www.example.com/example",
        "status":1
    }
    ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the data leakage prevention rule configuration (**dlp**) contains the following parameters:

    - **name**: String | Required | Rule name.
    - **conditions**: Array | Required | Matching conditions described in JSON string format. Supports up to two matching conditions, and the relationship between them is logical AND. It includes the following specific parameters:

        - **key**: Matching item.
            - **0**: Indicates the protected URL.
            - **10**: Indicates sensitive information.
            - **11**: Indicates response code.
        - **operation**: Matching logic. The value is fixed as **1**, indicating "contains".
        - **value**: Describes the matching condition values in JSON string format. Supports multiple condition values. It includes the following specific parameters:
            - **v**: Applicable only when the matching item (**key**) is URL (**0**) or response code (**11**).
                - URL: When `"key":0`, the parameter value is the URL address.
                - Response code: When `"key":11`, valid values include **400**, **401**, **402**, **403**, **404**, **405-499**, **500**, **501**, **502**, **503**, **504**, **505-599**.
            - **k**: Applicable only when the matching item (**key**) is sensitive information (**10**). Valid values:
                - **100**: Indicates ID card number.
                - **101**: Indicates credit card number.
                - **102**: Indicates phone number.
                - **103**: Indicates default sensitive words.
    - **action**: Matching action.
        - **3**: Indicates alerting.
        - **10**: Indicates sensitive information filtering. This action applies only to matching conditions where `"key":10`.
        - **11**: Indicates returning the system's built-in block page. This action applies only to matching conditions where `"key":11`.

    - **Sample**

  ```
  {
	"name":"example",
	"conditions":[{"key":11,"operation":1,"value":[{"v":401}]},{"key":"0","operation":1,"value":[{"v":"www.example.com"}]}],
	"action":3
  }
  ```

- The JSON string corresponding to the account security rule configuration (**ng_account**) contains the following parameters:

    - **domain**: String | Required | Domain name to protect.

    - **method**: String | Required | Request methods to monitor, including POST, GET, PUT, DELETE. Multiple request methods can be specified, separated by commas (`,`).

    - **url_path**: String | Required | API endpoint to monitor, represented as a URL path and must start with a forward slash (`/`).

    - **account_left**: String | Required | Account parameter name.

    - **password_left**: String | Optional | Password parameter name.

    - **action**: String | Required | Protection action. Valid values:
        - **monitor**: Indicates alerting.
        - **block**: Indicates blocking.

    - **Sample**

    ```
    {
        "domain":"www.example.com",
        "method":"GET,POST",
        "url_path":"/example",
        "account_left":"aaa",
        "action":"monitor"
    }
    ``` 

- The JSON string corresponding to the legitimate crawler rule configuration (**bot_crawler**) contains the following parameters:

    - **Status**: Integer | Required | Whether enabled. Valid values:
        - 0: Indicates disabled.
        - 1: Indicates enabled.
    - **Version**: Integer | Required | Rule version number.
    - **Content**: String | Required | Rule details described in JSON string format, including the following parameters:
        - **name**: String | Required | Rule name.
        - **conditions**: Array | Optional | Path protection conditions. For legitimate crawler rules, this is always empty, indicating all paths.
        - **expressions**: Array | Required | Rule conditional expressions, presented in a more readable format to represent all rule conditions.
        - **bypassTags**: String | Required | Modules to bypass. For legitimate crawler rules, this is fixed as **antibot**, indicating the bot management module.
        - **tags**: Array | Required | Protection function modules associated with the rule. For legitimate crawler rules, this is fixed as `["antibot"]`, indicating the bot management module.
    - **RuleId**: Integer | Required | Rule ID.
    - **Time**: String | Required | Latest modification time of the rule, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

    - **Sample**
    ```
    {
        "Status":0,
        "Version":1,
        "Content":{
            "name":"Baidu Spider Whitelist",
            "conditions":[],
            "expressions":["remote_addr inl 'ioc.210d077a-cf34-49ad-a9b3-0aa48095c595' && uri =^ '/'"],
            "bypassTags":"antibot",
            "tags":["antibot"]
        },
	"RuleId":20384,
	"Time":1585818161
    }
    ```
- The JSON string corresponding to the bot threat intelligence rule configuration (**bot_intelligence**) contains the following parameters:

    - **Status**: Integer | Required | Whether enabled. Valid values:
        - 0: Indicates disabled.
        - 1: Indicates enabled.
    - **Version**: Integer | Required | Rule version number.
    - **Content**: String | Required | Rule details described in JSON string format, including the following parameters:
        - **name**: String | Required | Rule name.
        - **action**: String | Required | Disposition action. Valid values:
            - **monitor**: Indicates observation.
            - **captcha**: Indicates slider CAPTCHA.
            - **captcha_strict**: Indicates strict slider CAPTCHA.
            - **js**: Indicates JavaScript validation.

>  You need to specify this parameter only when the value of the **AccessType** parameter is set to **waf-cloud-dns** and the **HttpsPort** parameter is not empty. If the HttpsPort parameter is not empty, your website uses HTTPS.

*   **ProtocolPortConfigs**: the list of protocol and port configurations. This field is required. Data type: array. Each element in a JSON array is a JSON struct that contains the following fields:

    *   **Protocol**: the protocol. This field is required. Data type: string. Valid values: **http** and **https**.

*   **CloudNativeProductName**: the type of the cloud service instance. This field is required. Data type: string. Valid values: **ECS**, **SLB**, and **ALB**.

ModifyProtectionModuleRule.description:
This API is used to modify the rule configuration in a specified WAF protection feature module, including web intrusion protection, data security, advanced mitigation, bot management, resource access management, rate limiting, whitelist, and other modules. You can specify the protection feature module by setting the **DefenseType** parameter. For the meanings of specific parameter values, see the description of the **DefenseType** request parameter.  
Note that to ensure system documentation integrity, the queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be rate-limited, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
ModifyProtectionModuleRule.requestParamsDescription: **Detailed description of Rule parameters** - The JSON string corresponding to the website tamper-proofing rule configuration (**tamperproof**) contains the following parameters: - **uri**: String | Required | The specific URL to be protected. - **name**: String | Required | The name of the rule. - **status**: Integer | Optional | The protection status of the rule. Valid values: - **0** (default): The rule is disabled. - **1**: The rule is enabled. - **Sample** ``` { "name":"example", "uri":"http://www.example.com/example", "status":1 } ``` - The JSON string corresponding to the data leakage prevention rule configuration (**dlp**) contains the following parameters: - **name**: String | Required | The name of the rule. - **conditions**: Array | Required | Matching conditions described in JSON string format. Up to two matching conditions can be configured, and the relationship between them is logical AND. The following sub-parameters are included: - **key**: Matching item. - **0**: Indicates the URL to be protected. - **10**: Indicates sensitive information. - **11**: Indicates response code. > You cannot configure matching conditions for both response code (**11**) and sensitive information (**10**) simultaneously in the **conditions** parameter. - **operation**: Matching logic. The value is fixed as **1**, indicating "contains". - **value**: Matching condition values described in JSON string format. Multiple values are supported. The following sub-parameters are included: - **v**: Applicable only when the matching item (**key**) is URL (**0**) or response code (**11**). - URL: When `"key":0`, the value is the URL address. - Response code: When `"key":11`, valid values include **400**, **401**, **402**, **403**, **404**, **405-499**, **500**, **501**, **502**, **503**, **504**, **505-599**. - **k**: Applicable only when the matching item (**key**) is sensitive information (**10**). Valid values: - **100**: Indicates ID card number. - **101**: Indicates credit card number. - **102**: Indicates phone number. - **103**: Indicates default sensitive words. - **action**: Matching action. - **3**: Indicates alerting. - **10**: Indicates sensitive information filtering. This action applies only to matching conditions where `"key":10`. - **11**: Indicates returning the system's built-in block page. This action applies only to matching conditions where `"key":11`. - **Sample** ``` { "name":"example", "conditions":[{"key":11,"operation":1,"value":[{"v":401}]},{"key":"0","operation":1,"value":[{"v":"www.example.com"}]}], "action":3 } ``` - The JSON string corresponding to the account security rule configuration (**ng_account**) contains the following parameters: - **url_path**: String | Required | The detection API endpoint, represented as a URL path that must start with "/". - **method**: String | Required | The request method(s) to be detected. Valid values: POST, GET, PUT, DELETE. Multiple methods can be specified, separated by commas (,). - **account_left**: String | Required | The account parameter name. - **password_left**: String | Optional | The password parameter name. - **action**: String | Required | The protection action. Valid values: - **monitor**: Indicates alerting. - **block**: Indicates blocking. - **Sample** ``` { "url_path":"/example", "method":"POST,GET,PUT,DELETE", "account_left":"aaa", "password_left":"123", "action":"monitor" } ``` - The JSON string corresponding to the bot threat intelligence configuration under bot management (**bot_intelligence**) contains the following parameters: - **name**: String | Required | The rule name, which must correspond to the Rule ID (**RuleId**) parameter. - **urlList**: Array | Required | Protection paths. Up to 10 paths can be specified. Represented as a JSON string containing the following sub-parameters: - **mode**: String | Required | Matching mode, used together with the path keyword (**url**) to specify the protection path. Valid values: **eq** (exact match), **prefix-match** (prefix match), **regex** (regular expression match). - **url**: String | Required | Path keyword, which must start with "/". - **action**: String | Required | Enforcement action. Valid values: - **monitor**: Indicates observation. - **captcha**: Indicates slider CAPTCHA. - **captcha_strict**: Indicates strict slider CAPTCHA. - **js**: Indicates JavaScript validation. - **block**: Indicates blocking. - **status**: Integer | Required | Enable status. Valid values: - **0**: Indicates disabled. - **1**: Indicates enabled. - **Sample** ``` { "urlList":[ {"mode":"prefix-match","url":"/indexa"}, {"mode":"regex","url":"/"}, {"mode":"eq","url":"/"}], "name":"IDC IP Library - Tencent Cloud", "action":"captcha_strict", "status":1 } ``` - The JSON string corresponding to the intelligent algorithm rule configuration under bot management (**bot_algorithm**) contains the following parameters: - **name**: String | Required | The rule name. - **algorithmName**: String | Required | Algorithm name. Valid values: - **RR**: Indicates dedicated resource crawler detection algorithm. - **PR**: Indicates targeted path crawler detection algorithm. - **DPR**: Indicates parameter polling crawler detection algorithm. - **SR**: Indicates dynamic IP crawler detection algorithm. - **IND**: Indicates proxy device crawler detection algorithm. - **Periodicity**: Indicates periodic crawler detection algorithm. - **timeInterval**: Integer | Required | Detection period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30, 60, 120, 300, 600. - **action**: String | Required | Enforcement action. Valid values: - **monitor**: Indicates observation. - **captcha**: Indicates slider CAPTCHA. - **js**: Indicates JavaScript validation. - **block**: Indicates blocking. Valid values: 0.01–1. - Configuration for the parameter polling crawler detection algorithm (**DPR**) includes the following sub-parameters: - **method**: String | Required | Request method. Valid values: 5–10000. - **minRatio**: Float | Required | Risk determination threshold, representing the minimum proportion of distinct key parameter values among all requests from an IP. For CC attack protection rules, the value is fixed as **custom_cc**. - **conditions**: Array | Required | Matching conditions. Up to five conditions can be configured. Represented as a JSON string containing: - **key**: Matching field. Valid values: **URL**, **IP**, **Referer**, **User-Agent**, **Params**, **Cookie**, **Content-Type**, **Content-Length**, **X-Forwarded-For**, **Post-Body**, **Http-Method**, **Header**, **URLPath**. - **opCode**: Logical operator. Valid values: - **0**: Indicates "does not contain" or "does not belong to". - **1**: Indicates "contains" or "belongs to". - **2**: Indicates "does not exist". - **10**: Indicates "not equal to". - **11**: Indicates "equal to". - **20**: Indicates "length less than". - **21**: Indicates "length equal to". - **22**: Indicates "length greater than". - **30**: Indicates "value less than". - **31**: Indicates "value equal to". - **32**: Indicates "value greater than". - **values**: Matching content. Fill in the appropriate content as a String. > The valid values for the logical operator (**opCode**) and matching content (**values**) depend on the specified matching field (**key**). - **action**: String | Required | Enforcement action. Valid values: - **monitor**: Indicates observation. - **captcha**: Indicates slider CAPTCHA. - **captcha_strict**: Indicates strict slider CAPTCHA. - **js**: Indicates JavaScript validation. - **block**: Indicates blocking. - **ratelimit**: JSON format | Required | Rate limiting settings. Represented as a JSON string containing: - **target**: String | Required | Statistic object type. Valid values: - **remote_addr**: Indicates IP. - **cookie.acw_tc**: Indicates session. - **queryarg**: Indicates custom parameter. If selected, the **subkey** parameter must specify the custom parameter name. - **cookie**: Indicates custom cookie. If selected, the **subkey** parameter must specify the cookie name. - **header**: Indicates custom header. Represented as a JSON string containing: - **code**: Integer | Required | Specified response code. - **count**: Integer | Optional | Occurrence count threshold. If the specified response code occurs more than this number of times, the protection rule is triggered. Valid values: 1–999999999. Either **count** or **ratio** must be configured, but not both. - **ratio**: Integer | Optional | Occurrence ratio threshold (percentage). Valid values: - **rule**: Indicates within the current feature matching scope. - **domain**: Indicates within the domain scope of the current rule. - **ttl**: Integer | Required | Duration of the enforcement action. For details, see [Custom Protection Rule Groups](~~99262~~). - **regularTypes**: Array | Optional | List of protection rule types to exclude from detection. This parameter is required if **tags** includes **regular_type**. Valid values: - **sqli**: Indicates SQL injection. - **xss**: Indicates cross-site scripting (XSS). - **code_exec**: Indicates code execution. - **lfilei**: Indicates local file inclusion. - **rfilei**: Indicates remote file inclusion. - **webshell**: Indicates WebShell. - **vvip**: Indicates custom protection rules. - **other**: Indicates other types. - **conditions**: Array | Required | Matching conditions. Up to five conditions can be configured. Represented as a JSON string containing: - **key**: Matching field. Valid values: **URL**, **IP**, **Referer**, **User-Agent**, **Params**, **Cookie**, **Content-Type**, **Content-Length**, **X-Forwarded-For**, **Post-Body**, **Http-Method**, **Header**, **URLPath**. - **opCode**: Logical operator. Valid values: - **0**: Indicates "does not contain" or "does not belong to". - **1**: Indicates "contains" or "belongs to". - **2**: Indicates "does not exist". - **10**: Indicates "not equal to". - **11**: Indicates "equal to". - **20**: Indicates "length less than". - **21**: Indicates "length equal to". - **22**: Indicates "length greater than". - **30**: Indicates "value less than". - **31**: Indicates "value equal to". - **32**: Indicates "value greater than". - **values**: Matching content. Fill in the appropriate content as a String. > The valid values for the logical operator (**opCode**) and matching content (**values**) depend on the specified matching field (**key**). - **Sample** ``` { "name": "test", "tags": ["cc","customrule"], "conditions":[{"opCode":1,"key":"URL","values":"/example"}], } ``` When calling the API, in addition to the request parameters described in this topic, you must also include Alibaba Cloud common request parameters. schema.description:
The ID of the WAF resource that you want to manage.

After you add a domain name to WAF for protection, the domain name becomes a WAF resource. The Resource Management service uses a resource ID to uniquely identify each WAF resource. The resource ID is in the `<InstanceId>~<Domain>` format. The following list describes the parameters:

- `<InstanceId>`: the ID of the WAF instance. You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

- `<Domain>`: the domain name that is protected by the WAF instance. You can call the [DescribeDomainList](~~255880~~) operation to query all domain names that are protected by the WAF instance.

- The resource ID of a WAF domain name resource consists of the `<InstanceId>` and `<Domain>` parameters that are connected with a tilde (\~).

The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the WAF resource.

After you create a resource group in the Resource Management service, the service generates a unique ID for the resource group. This is the resource group ID.

You can view the IDs of all resource groups on the **Resource Groups** page in the [Resource Management console](https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups). You can also call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the IDs of all resource groups.
The type of the WAF resource. Set the value to **domain**. This indicates that the resource type is a domain name.

MoveResourceGroup.description:
A WAF resource is a domain name that is protected by WAF. A resource group is a feature that lets you manage resources in groups under an Alibaba Cloud account. Resource groups simplify resource management and user authorization for multiple projects or applications within a single Alibaba Cloud account. By default, domain names protected by WAF belong to the default resource group. You can move WAF domain name resources to your custom resource groups.

You can create resource groups in the Alibaba Cloud Management Console. For more information, see [](t24429.xdita#). You can also create resource groups by calling the [](t1872464.xdita#)operation of Resource Management.

For more information about resource groups, see [](t24420.xdita#).

The enable status of the Intelligent Rule Hosting feature. Valid values:
- **0**: Disabled.
- **1** (default): Enabled.

Intelligent Rule Hosting allows WAF to intelligently learn behavior patterns from historical service traffic, detect protection rules that may cause false positives for normal business operations, and automatically add Web intrusion protection whitelist entries to disable those rules in specific business scenarios. Once the false positive threat is eliminated, the disabled rules are recovered.

SetDomainRuleGroup.title: Configure a Protection Rule Group for a Domain Name
SetDomainRuleGroup.summary: Configure a protection rule group for a specified domain name to be used by the regex protection engine. In addition to the three system default rule groups, you can also select a custom rule group.
SetDomainRuleGroup.description:
This API is used to configure the protection rule group for the Protection Rules Engine and set the enable status of the Intelligent Rule Hosting feature for a specified domain name.

When configuring a protection rule group, in addition to using the built-in Normal, Strict, and Loose rule groups provided by WAF, you can also select a custom rule group. Note that to ensure system stability, the queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be rate-limited, which may impact your service. Please invoke the API appropriately.

><notice> Currently, creating custom rule groups via API is not supported. You must first create a rule group and obtain its rule group ID on the **Protection Rule Groups** page under **System Administration** in the [Web Application Firewall console](https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=wafnext) before you can invoke this API to apply the custom rule group to a domain name.
></notice>
